s: Debarim shennohagim leekol berosh hashshana ubo t' seipim: yehe adam ragil leekol berosh hashshana karti, sileqa dehaynu teradin, tamre, qara, rubbeya dehaynu tiltan, vehu haddin mah shenniqra bilshonot acherim leshon ribbuy yoklu kol anshe medina umedina kilshonam. Ukesheokel rubbeya vekayyotze bo yomar "yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyirbu zekuyyotenu", ukesheyyokal karti yomar "yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyikkaretu soneenu", ukesheyyokal sileqa yomar "yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyistallequ oyebenu", ukesheyyokal tamre yomar "yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyittammu soneenu", ukesheyyokal qara yomar "yehi ratzon millepaneka sheyyiqqara gezar dinenu veyiqqareu lepaneka zekuyyotenu". Veyesh nohagim leekol tappuach matoq metubbal bidbash veomerim "titchaddesh alenu shana metuqa", vibarek al hattappuach velo al haddebash, lepi shehaddebash hu tapel lattappuach:
Veyesh okelim dagim liprot velirbot kedagim, veen mebashshelim bechometz:
Kol hamminim shetztzarik lebarek kesheokelam betok hasseuda kegon tappuchim utemarim yomar habbaqqasha achar hatchalat haakila, mippene sheasur lehapsiq ben habberaka laakila:

Veyesh nohagim litbol perusat hammotzi bidbash. Veyesh okelin rimmonim veomerim "narbeh zekuyyot karimmon". Venohagin leekol basar shamen velishtot debash vekol mine metiqa, kede shettehe hashshana hazzot metuqa ushemena, veken katub beezra "iklu mashmannim ushetu mamtaqqim":
Yesh leekol rosh ayil zeker leelo shel yitzchaq, veim en rosh ayil — yokal rosh kebes, veim en rosh kebes — yokal rosh acher, lomar nihyeh lerosh velo lezanab:
Yesh medaqdeqim shello leekol egozim veluzim (perush egozim qetannim), mippene shehem marbim kicha venia umebattelim hattepilla:

Venohagim lelek el hannahar sheyyesh bo dagim chayyim, lesiman shello tishlot banu ayin hara venipreh venirbeh kedagim, veomerim sham pasuq "yashub yerachamenu vego' vetashlik vego'". Vetob sheyyihyeh michutz lair. Veyesh lelek beyom rishon shel rosh hashshana achar mincha qodem sheqiat hachamma, velomar pasuq "mi el kamoka vego'":
Venohagin shello lishon beyom rosh hashshana, kede shello yishan mazzalo. Vehayyosheb ubatel — hare zeh keyashen. Veyesh nohagim lishon achar chatzot hayyom:
